title: Delegation Authority
description: Authority level granted to a delegated agent operating against a campaign plan.

enumDescriptions.full: Can execute any action within the delegation's budget and market constraints.
enumDescriptions.execute_only: Can execute pre-approved actions but cannot initiate new campaigns or reallocate budget. A pre-approved action is one whose opaque action binding already holds an approved intent check in the plan's lifecycle: the delegate may act only on such an action, and may not initiate an intent check that would create a new binding or increase committed spend.
enumDescriptions.propose_only: Can propose actions for governance review but cannot execute without explicit approval.
